# gitlab fixtures: where each one comes from

Fixtures were built from the forge's official API documentation unless a row says it was recorded from a live server (tokens and personal data removed). Every fixture in this folder must have a row here (checked by `fixture_hygiene`).

| Fixture | Source | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user.json` | REST "Get the current user" example, regular user ([users](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/users/)) | from docs, not live-verified | `GET /user` as the token check is documented; the example has `bot: false` (spec 15 "`bot` flag on users": documented on the example, meaning not described) |
| `user.headers.json` | `RateLimit-Limit` / `RateLimit-Remaining` "on all responses" ([gitlab.com rate limits](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/gitlab_com/rate_limits/)); values made up | from docs, not live-verified | header names only; self-managed instances may send none |
| `personal_access_token_self.json` | "Retrieve a personal access token" with the `self` keyword ([PAT API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/personal_access_tokens/)); the page has no example for `self`, so the list example's fields are used; `expires_at` is `YYYY-MM-DD` (rotate example); `{expires}` is replaced by the test | from docs, not live-verified | `scopes`, `expires_at`, `active` names |
| `projects_page1.json` | "List all projects" ([projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/)), trimmed; `membership`, `archived`, `simple` are documented parameters | from docs, not live-verified | spec 15 "`/projects` parameters": documented. Which fields `simple=true` keeps is not documented (nit needs `path_with_namespace`; `visibility` is read when present) |
| `projects_page1.headers.json` | `Link` and `x-next-page` ([REST pagination](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/)); `{base}` is replaced by the test server | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `projects_page2.json` | as page 1 | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `projects_page2.headers.json` | `x-next-page` without `Link` (synthetic: tests the `x-next-page` fallback) | synthetic, not live-verified | whether GitLab ever sends one without the other: UNVERIFIED |
| `projects_page3.json` | as page 1 | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `projects_page3.headers.json` | empty `x-next-page` on the last page (assumed; the docs do not say what the last page carries) | synthetic, not live-verified | |
| `projects_live_page1.json` | recorded from GitLab 19.5.1 (self-managed, reached at `http://gitlab.example:8080`, `external_url` `https://gitlab.example:8443`), 2026-11-15: the `root/nit-live-test` entry of `/projects?simple=true`; `avatar_url` values nulled and `ssh_url_to_repo` dropped (not read by nit) | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | `web_url` / `http_url_to_repo` carry the external URL, not the address used |
| `projects_live_page1.headers.json` | the paging headers of the same answer with `per_page=1` (lower-cased names, values as sent) | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | **`Link` points at the external URL** (`https://...:8443`), another origin than the API base; `x-next-page` is on it too |
| `projects_live_page2.json` | synthetic second entry in the live shape (`root/nit-live-test-2` does not exist) | synthetic | |
| `projects_live_page2.headers.json` | the last-page headers of the same live query (page 13 of 13), `x-page` set to 2 | live-recorded 2026-11-15 (one value edited) | the last page sends an empty `x-next-page` and no `rel="next"` |
| `mrs_opened.json` | "List project merge requests" example ([MR API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/)), trimmed; a fork MR (`source_project_id` differs), a draft, a bot author (`bot: true`) and one broken entry (no `title`, synthetic) | from docs + synthetic, not live-verified | **the list has no `changes_count`** (only "Get single MR" has it): the spec's 8.2 statement is wrong, sizes come from the single MR (`diffstat()`) |
| `mrs_updated.json` | same list shape: the answer to `updated_after` with one MR changed | from docs, not live-verified | `updated_after` returns MRs updated "on or after" the time (docs) |
| `mrs_merged.json` | same list shape with `state: merged` / `closed`; third entry broken (synthetic) | from docs + synthetic, not live-verified | `state=merged&source_branch=` are documented filters |
| `mr_detail.json` | "Get single MR" example: `changes_count` (a string), `diff_refs` (`base_sha`, `head_sha`, `start_sha`) | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `mr_detail_1000plus.json` | same, `changes_count: "1000+"` (docs: capped at 1000, returns the string `"1000+"`) | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `mr_detail_empty_diff_refs.json` | same, `diff_refs` and `changes_count` empty right after creation (docs: "Empty when the merge request is created, and populates asynchronously"); `null` is assumed for "empty" | from docs, not live-verified | whether "empty" is `null`, `{}` or empty strings: UNVERIFIED (nit treats all three as empty) |
| `mr_versions.json` | "Retrieve merge request diff versions" example (`head_commit_sha`, `base_commit_sha`, `start_commit_sha`), newest first in the example | from docs, not live-verified | order not stated in the docs: nit takes the highest `id` |
| `mr_reviewers.json` | "Retrieve merge request reviewers" example (`user`, `state`, `created_at`); the docs example shows only `unreviewed` / `reviewed`; `requested_changes` is from the GLQL field list cited in spec 2 | from docs, not live-verified | `requested_changes` on this endpoint: UNVERIFIED |
| `mr_reviewers_approved.json` | same shape with `state: approved` (GLQL list) | from docs, not live-verified | UNVERIFIED on this endpoint |
| `mr_approvals.json` | "Retrieve approval state for a merge request", Community Edition fields (`approved`, `approved_by[].user`, `user_has_approved`) ([approvals](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_request_approvals/)); Free tier | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `discussions.json` | "List all merge request discussion items" example ([discussions](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/)): DiffNotes with `position` (added, removed, context with `line_range`, a rename, `position_type: file`, a note on an older head), an individual note, a system note, a bot note, and a note without `id` (synthetic) | from docs + synthetic, not live-verified | `position_type: file` is a documented create value; how GitLab returns it on read: UNVERIFIED. `line_range.start.type` for a context line assumed `null`. Bot flag on note authors: UNVERIFIED |
| `rate_limit_429.json` | 429 body (the docs show none; assumed `{"message": ...}`) | synthetic, not live-verified | nit reads only the status and headers |
| `rate_limit_429.headers.json` | `Retry-After` (seconds) and `RateLimit-*` on throttled answers (same page); `{retry_after}` replaced by the test | from docs, not live-verified | |
| `unauthorized_401.json` | the usual `{"message": "401 Unauthorized"}` body (not shown on the cited pages) | synthetic, not live-verified | nit reads only the status |
| `discussion_live_added.json` | recorded from GitLab 19.5.1 (self-managed, address replaced by `gitlab.example:8080`), 2026-11-15: `GET .../discussions/:id` of a discussion created by `POST .../discussions` with `position {new_line: 5}` (an added line) on the throwaway MR; `avatar_url` nulled | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | the create answer has the same shape (discussion with `notes[]`); `position` after later pushes shows the moved head and line |
| `discussion_live_stale_range.json` | same instance and day: a multi-line discussion (`line_range` new 6..8) read after two pushes, with GitLab's system reply "changed this line in version 4" | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | **`new_line` moved to 12 but `line_range` stayed 6..8**: GitLab never rewrites `line_range`; the system note's link carries GitLab's own line code `sha1(path)_<old>_<new>` |
| `mr_versions_live.json` | same instance and day: `GET .../versions` of the throwaway MR after three pushes (newest first) | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | |
| `mr_version_live_861.json` | same instance and day: `GET .../versions/861` (first version) with `commits` and `diffs` (`small.txt` added/removed/changed lines, `big.txt` a far hunk at 2197, `old-name.txt` renamed to `new-name.txt`); commit author is the default `admin@example.com` | live-recorded 2026-11-15 | the `diff` text is what nit locates lines in |
